scenario: Member A can view Member A's tasks
evidence: Returns A1, A2, A3 only; progress converted to percent.

scenario: Member A cannot view Member B's tasks
evidence: Response contains no B task IDs, content, email or evaluation text, even when the body names B's member ID and email.

scenario: Member A cannot edit Member B's tasks
evidence: B1 unchanged; "not yours" and "does not exist" return the identical error. Denial written to Audit Log.

scenario: Member A cannot change deadlines, assignments, supervisor feedback or evaluation records
evidence: 15 protected columns each rejected with the sheet unchanged. No evaluation endpoint exists (unknown actions refused). Mixed payloads (allowed + forbidden field) are rejected whole.

scenario: A supervisor can view and manage all authorised tasks
evidence: Supervisors work directly in the private master workbook through Google Sheets sharing (Editor on named accounts). The API deliberately has no supervisor mode. Needs a live check with real supervisor accounts after sharing is configured.

scenario: No bypass via task ID, query/URL parameter or submitted values
evidence: Altered IDs (case, spaces, injection strings, arrays, objects, null), body memberId/email and query params all fail; sheet unchanged. doGet returns no data.

scenario: Unauthenticated users cannot access private task data
evidence: Missing, malformed, expired, wrong-audience, wrong-issuer, unverified-email and unknown tokens, a valid Google account not in the directory, bad JSON, and an unconfigured client ID all return no data.

scenario: Deactivated members can no longer access the member interface
evidence: Inactive status, past Programme End, and a live flip to Inactive all block the next request.

scenario: Formula-driven and confidential fields cannot be modified through the update workflow
evidence: Formula/script-set columns refused; members cannot set Completed; Approved/Completed tasks locked; text starting with "=" is stored as text-formatted plain text (mock verifies format call, not Sheets rendering).
